factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table shows EBITDA 2025: 3,458 thousand euros (€3.458M) vs 2024: 4,536 thousand euros (€4.536M); operating profit 2025: 3,359 thousand euros (€3.359M) vs 2024: 4,332 thousand euros (€4.332M).

factual_claims.claim: Margins also weakened: the gross profit margin declined to 15.9% from 17.6%, the operating margin to 9.5% from 11.3%, and the net profit margin to 2.9% from 5.6%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Ratios table shows gross profit margin 2025: 15.9% vs 2024: 17.6%; operating profit margin 2025: 9.5% vs 2024: 11.3%; net profit margin 2025: 2.9% vs 2024: 5.6%.

factual_claims.claim: The weaker annual performance primarily reflected fewer apartment handovers, at 141 compared with 194 in 2024, lower gross margins on development projects, and higher marketing expenses of €1.3 million versus €0.9 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 24 states: sold 141 apartments in 2025 (194 in 2024); gross margin 16.9% in 2025 (17.8% in 2024); marketing expenses €1.3 million in 2025 (€0.9 million in 2024).

factual_claims.claim: Marketing costs increased because the Group had more and larger projects on sale, requiring more intensive sales activity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 24: increase in marketing expenses was 'primarily attributable to the growth in the number scale of projects on sale, which resulted in more intensive sales and marketing activities.'

factual_claims.claim: Finance costs and personnel expenses remained broadly unchanged, while interest income increased by €0.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 24 states finance costs and personnel expenses 'remained at the same level as in the previous year'; Note 18.1 shows interest income increased from €421k (2024) to €712k (2025), a €291k increase (€0.291M).

factual_claims.claim: Other operating income also increased, partly because properties were reclassified from inventories to investment property and revalued.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 24: 'reclassification of inventories to investment property resulted in other operating income totalling 0.8 million euros (2024: 0.3 million euros)' due to fair value revaluation.

factual_claims.claim: Fourth-quarter performance deteriorated substantially.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 24: Q4 2025 net loss of €0.5 million vs Q4 2024 net profit of €1.0 million; revenue, gross profit, and operating profit all declined significantly.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue fell to €4.5 million from €10.5 million, gross profit to €0.7 million from €2.5 million, and operating profit to €0.3 million from €2.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table shows Q4 2025 revenue 4,526 thousand euros (€4.526M) vs Q4 2024 10,542 thousand euros (€10.542M); gross profit Q4 2025 694 thousand euros (€0.694M) vs Q4 2024 2,531 thousand euros (€2.531M); operating profit Q4 2025 346 thousand euros (€0.346M) vs Q4 2024 1,998 thousand euros (€1.998M).

factual_claims.claim: The Group recorded a net loss of €0.5 million, compared with a €1.0 million profit in the fourth quarter of 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table shows Q4 2025 net profit/(loss) -422 thousand euros (€-0.422M) vs Q4 2024 957 thousand euros (€0.957M); Management Report page 24 confirms net loss of €0.5 million in Q4 2025 vs profit of €1.0 million in Q4 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The quarter included €0.8 million of other operating income from the fair-value revaluation of properties reclassified to investment property, but this did not offset lower sales and margins.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 24: €0.8 million other operating income from reclassification and fair value revaluation of properties; lower sales and margins evident in Q4 revenue, gross profit, and operating profit declines.

factual_claims.claim: Despite lower completed sales, market activity improved.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 5 and Main events detail expanded development portfolio, new projects, and increased primary sales agreements (185 homes vs 109 homes in 2024), indicating improved market activity.

factual_claims.claim: The Group concluded primary sales agreements for 185 homes worth €36.1 million, nearly twice the 109 homes and €19.8 million recorded in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 5: 'concluded primary sales agreements for 185 homes... total value of 36.1 million euros, which is nearly twice as much as in 2024 (109 homes and 19.8 million euros)'.

factual_claims.claim: Stabilised interest rates and a positive economic outlook in Estonia and Latvia supported demand, while projects entering construction expanded supply.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 5: growth supported by 'stable financial environment with stabilised interest rates and a positive economic growth outlook... several projects that had previously been in the preparation phase entered the construction stage.'

factual_claims.claim: The development portfolio grew to 33 active projects with approximately 196,650 square metres of sellable area.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Overview of development projects page 11: 'As at 31 December 2025, the Group has a total of 33 active development projects... and 196,650 square metres of sellable area.'

factual_claims.claim: Homes under construction increased to 428 from 192, a 223% increase, following the launch of projects in Estonia and Latvia.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Residential development projects under construction page 8: 'As at 31 December 2025, the company had 428 apartments under construction (31 December 2024: 192 apartments), representing a 223% increase... in Estonia, 201... in Latvia, 227.'

factual_claims.claim: The Group strengthened its project pipeline and financing during the year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report and Main events detail portfolio expansion (six new residential projects), joint venture establishment, bond issuance (€8.0 million), and increased equity; Key financials show equity growth and active development projects.

factual_claims.claim: It added six residential projects representing approximately 700 planned apartments and 2,500 square metres of commercial space, and established a joint venture with EfTEN for the Lasnamäe development.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report page 5: expanded portfolio by six residential projects with ~700 apartments and 2,500 m² commercial space; Main events page 18-19 detail joint venture with EfTEN Special Opportunities Fund for Lasnamäe development.

factual_claims.claim: In November, Hepsor raised €8.0 million through bonds carrying a 9.50% annual interest rate.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Main events page 19: 'In November 2025, the Group raised 8.0 million euros through a public bond issuance. The bonds carry a fixed annual interest rate of 9.50%... first interest payment will be made on 26 February 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: Year-end assets were €91.8 million, up 3.4%, while equity increased 23.0% to €27.1 million, partly due to a €5.8 million non-cash contribution from a non-controlling interest.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table: total assets 2025 91,835 thousand euros (€91.835M) vs 2024 88,813 thousand euros (€88.813M) [3.4% increase]; equity 2025 27,078 thousand euros (€27.078M) vs 2024 22,010 thousand euros (€22.01M) [23.0% increase]; Note 11: €5.8 million non-cash contribution from non-controlling interest in Hepsor PHX5 OÜ.

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing loans fell to €47.7 million from €54.7 million, although cash decreased to €3.8 million from €6.2 million and annual net cash flow was negative at €2.6 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table: loans and borrowings 2025 47,747 thousand euros (€47.747M) vs 2024 54,688 thousand euros (€54.688M); cash and cash equivalents 2025 3,821 thousand euros (€3.821M) vs 2024 6,249 thousand euros (€6.249M); Cash flow statement: net cash flow 2025 -2,597 thousand euros (€-2.597M).
